This [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Revan" /> In [[3950 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> she was chosen by [[Murtog]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]]' security force, along with [[Unidentified male soldier (Dromund Kaas)|two]] [[Unidentified female soldier (Sai tok)|other]] soldiers to be part of a team that would [[Operation supernova|ambush]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]] in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] outside of the [[Kaas City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Dromund Kaas. During the skirmish, Surik's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[T3-M4]] used his headlamp to temporarily blind the soldiers who immediately opened fire on reflex. They forced Surik to dodge their fire and in response Surik [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] and [[Shiak|ran]] her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] through a nearby male soldier, and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|throw]] the female soldier against one of the cave walls, [[Death/Legends|killing]] her on impact.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The female soldier first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
